name: How long does permitting take for an ADU?

mainEntity.name: How long does permitting take for an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many areas offer streamlined permitting (30-60 days) for ADUs under 1,200 sq ft that meet ministerial standards without discretionary review or public hearings.
